result.text: This is where the familiar talk of widening your "window of tolerance" becomes practical. Titration, pendulation, and orientation each ask the same question: can you touch something difficult in a small enough dose, notice what happens, and return? Some people may spend three to six months mainly building these capacities, and severe developmental trauma can take longer. I would treat that as a rough guide, not a countdown. If you are stable and have one clear target, you may be ready for focused trauma work much sooner.
